standards.text: Feeder loading assessments must be refreshed within 30 days of any reconfiguration event.
standards.title: Feeder loading assessment freshness

standards.text: Substation totals must equal the sum of connected feeder loads within a 0.5 MW tolerance.
standards.title: Substation total consistency

standards.text: Protection settings must be re-verified after any feeder load change exceeding 10%.
standards.title: Protection re-verification trigger
